properties.site-address: Reading Arch Road Industrial Estate, Redhill
properties.notes: The site in its current state is not considered to provide a fitting approach to the town centre gateway along the important approach route. The site does not currently maximise its potential. The site has been allocated in the DMP for mixed-use development (retail and residential use) (DMP site allocation policy RED8). The DMP requires redevelopment of the site to secure the relocation of the active uses to suitable alternative premises elsewhere in the borough. Development of the site for retail uses would be dependent upon a full assessment of the impact on the town centre. The site partially falls within Flood Zones 2 and 3. The Redhill Brook is partially culverted under the site.
